infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Only while you record a voice message to send in a chat. Voice messages are encrypted on your phone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To pick a photo to send in a chat or to use as your neighborhood’s cover. Only the photos you choose are used.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: To scan a neighbor’s QR code so you can connect in person.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Only if you ask to copy a plan into your calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Only if you ask to copy a plan into your calendar.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: To unlock It’s a Lifestyle when you’ve turned on the app lock.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Only when you choose to share where you are in a chat. It’s rounded to about 1 km and never tracked in the background.
